title: A Full List of Current 2026 K-Pop Concerts (Updating)
summary: From KATSEYE to BOYNEXTDOOR, here's what you can expect from the K-pop concert scene this year.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

There are enough K-pop concerts and world tours this year to make keeping track of who’s touring where a challenge.

As the genre becomes more popular in the States and across the globe, artists have begun expanding their horizons, taking their tours beyond Asia to stop in North America and beyond. That’s not even including the K-pop acts headlining music festivals and conventions this year.

On the docket for 2026, we’ve seen big names embark on massive world tours and even Las Vegas residencies, like BLACKPINK’s Lisa’s Viva La Lisa . Epik High, BOYNEXTDOOR and KATSEYE are just a few big names touring towards the end of the year, with more artists announcing tours all the time. To keep you in the know, we’ve compiled a list of K-pop concerts happening in 2026 so far and where you can buy tickets. As always, keep in mind that the official spot to grab tickets to all of these events will be via Ticketmaster . That being said, we’ve also included links to resale and third-party sites.
